crossRefs.note: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to…

people.name: Gedaliah
people.line: Appointed governor of Judah by Babylonians; assassinated by Ishmael.

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

translations.web: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and gathered very much wine and summer fruits.
translations.bsb: they all returned from all the places to which they had been banished and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah at Mizpah. And they gathered an abundance of wine grapes and summer fruit.
translations.kjv: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.
translations.asv: then all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.
